# De gode genene

Bærekraftig havbruk starter med å velge den sterkeste rogna med de beste genene. Kraften i
genetikken vår sikrer produsenter over hele verden en effektiv, sikker og ansvarlig produksjon av
fisk – helt fra starten av.

## Rogn

Vi produserer genetisk startmateriale; fiskeegg med råsterk genetikk som gir en svært robust og
frisk fisk som yter godt.

## Stamfisk

Vi forvalter og utvikler den norske koden - det eldste vitenskapelige avlsprogrammet for atlantisk
laks og regnbueørret.

## Forskning

Avansert genomikk og banebrytende forskning på sykdomsresistens, vekst og et stadig mer bærekraftig
havbruk.

[AquaGen-rogna]

## Såkorn for livskraft

Rogna vår sikrer et ansvarlig, lønnsomt og bærekraftig oppdrett av atlantisk laks og fjordørret.
Produktene våre sørger for god ytelse og vekst hos fisken og oppfyller de strengeste kvalitetskrav
til sunn og velsmakende mat.

[ Våre arter og produkter ][12]

## Fra vitenskap til matfat hviler et stort ansvar.

Nøkkelen til å nå mange av **FNs bærekraftsmål **ligger i havet. Gjennom hele syklusen fra vitenskap
til matfat forplikter vi oss til en bærekraftig verdiskaping på den tredelte bunnlinjen; miljø,
samfunn og økonomi. God ytelse på én bunnlinje skal ikke gå på bekostning av god ytelse på en annen.
Gjennom en sikker produksjon og en sikker leveranse sørger vi for at oppdrettere alltid mottar et
genetisk startmateriale som er optimalisert for fisk, miljø og mennesker.

Vel, vi trodde det.

## Alt nytt starter med noe lite

Play Video

Alt nytt starter med noe lite. En dråpe, et frø, et egg. Troen på at noe lite kan bli starten på noe
mye større. Noe viktig. Noe som kan forandre verden. For hvem hadde trodd at en laks som svømte
lykkelig rundt i Nidelva for 50 år siden skulle bli stamfar til milliarder av fisk jorden rundt?
Vel, vi trodde det.

### **Personvernerklæring**

Personvernerklæringen handler om hvordan denne nettsiden samler inn og bruker informasjon om
besøkende. Erklæringen inneholder informasjon du har krav på når det samles inn opplysninger fra
nettstedet vårt, og generell informasjon om hvordan vi behandler personopplysninger. Juridisk eier
av nettsiden er behandlingsansvarlig for virksomhetens behandling av personopplysninger. Det er
frivillig for de som besøker nettsidene å oppgi personopplysninger i forbindelse med tjenester som å
motta nyhetsbrev og benytte del- og tipstjenesten. Behandlingsgrunnlaget er samtykke fra den
enkelte, med mindre annet er spesifisert.

#### **1. Webanalyse og informasjonskapsler (cookies)**

Som en viktig del av arbeidet med å lage et brukervennlig nettsted, ser vi på brukermønsteret til de
som besøker nettstedet. For å analysere informasjonen, bruker vi analyseverktøyet [Google
Analytics][18]. Google Analytics bruker informasjonskapsler/cookies (små tekstfiler som nettstedet
lagrer på brukerens datamaskin), som registrerer brukernes IP-adresse, og som gir informasjon om den
enkelte brukers bevegelser på nett. Eksempler på hva statistikken gir oss svar på er; hvor mange som
besøker ulike sider, hvor lenge besøket varer, hvilke nettsteder brukerne kommer fra og hvilke
nettlesere som benyttes. Ingen av informasjonskapslene gjør at vi kan knytte informasjon om din bruk
av nettstedet til deg som enkeltperson. Informasjonen som samles inn av Google Analytics, lagres på
Googles servere i USA. Mottatte opplysninger er underlagt [Googles retningslinjer for
personvern][19]. En IP-adresse er definert som en personopplysning fordi den kan spores tilbake til
en bestemt maskinvare og dermed til en enkeltperson. Vi bruker Google Analytics sin sporingskode som
[anonymiserer IP-adressen][20] før informasjonen lagres og bearbeides av Google. Dermed kan ikke den
lagrede IP-adressen brukes til å identifisere den enkelte brukeren.

#### **2. Søk**

Hvis nettsiden har søkefunksjon så lagrer informasjon om hvilke søkeord brukerne benytter i Google
Analytics. Formålet med lagringen er å gjøre informasjonstilbudet vårt bedre. Bruksmønsteret for søk
lagres i aggregert form. Det er bare søkeordet som lagres, og de kan ikke kobles til andre
opplysninger om brukerne, slik som til IP-adressene.

#### **3. Del/tips-tjenesten**

Funksjonen "Del med andre" kan brukes til å videresende lenker til nettstedet på e-post, eller til å
dele innholdet på sosiale nettsamfunn. Opplysninger om tips logges ikke hos oss, men brukes kun der
og da til å legge inn tipset hos nettsamfunnet. Vi kan imidlertid ikke garantere at nettsamfunnet
ikke logger disse opplysningene. Alle slike tjenester bør derfor brukes med vett. Dersom du benytter
e-postfunksjonen, bruker vi bare de oppgitte e-postadressene til å sende meldingen videre uten noen
form for lagring.

#### **4. Nyhetsbrev**

Nettsiden kan sende ut nyhetsbrev via epost hvis du har registrert deg for å motta dette. For at vi
skal kunne sende e-post må du registrere en e-postadresse. Mailchimp er databehandler for
nyhetsbrevet. E-postadressen lagres i en egen database, deles ikke med andre og slettes når du sier
opp abonnementet. E-postadressen slettes også om vi får tilbakemelding om at den ikke er aktiv.

#### **5. Påmelding, skjema**

Nettsiden kan ha skjema for påmelding, kontaktskjema eller andre skjema. Disse skjemaene er
tilgjengeliggjort for publikum for å utføre de oppgaver de er ment å gjøre. Påmeldingsskjema er for
at besøkende kan melde seg på eller registrere seg. Kontaktskjema er for at besøkende enkelt kan
sende en melding til nettsidens kontaktperson. Vi ber da om navnet på innsender og
kontaktinformasjon til denne. Personopplysninger vi mottar blir ikke benyttet til andre formål enn å
svare på henvendelsen. Skjema sendes som epost via Mailgun som tredjepartsløsning. Hele innsendelen
blir lagret hos Mailgun i 24 timer. Mellom 24 timer og 30 dager er det kun mailheader som blir
oppbevart før innsendelsen blir slettet etter 30 dager. Årsaken til denne lagringen er for å
bekrefte om eposter blir sendt fra nettsiden og videresendt til riktig mottaker. Når eposten er
mottatt av mottaker så er det opp til mottaker å avgjøre Databehandlingsbehovet av eposten.

#### **6. Side- og tjenestefunksjonalitet**

Det blir brukt informasjonskapsler i drift og presentasjon av data fra nettsteder. Slike
informasjonskapsler kan inneholde informasjon om språkkode for språk valgt av brukeren. Det kan være
informasjonskapsler med informasjon som støtter om lastbalanseringen av systemet slik at alle
brukere blir sikret en best mulig opplevelse. Ved tjenester som krever innlogging eller søk kan det
bli brukt informasjonskapsler som sikrer at tjenesten presenterer data til rett mottaker.

#### **7. Hvordan håndtere informasjonskapsler i din nettleser**

På [www.nettvett.no][21] kan du lese om hvordan du [stiller inn nettleseren for å godta/avvise
informasjonskapsler,][22] og få [tips til sikrere bruk av internett][23].

# De gode genene

Bærekraftig havbruk starter med å velge den sterkeste rogna med de beste genene. Kraften i
genetikken vår sikrer produsenter over hele verden en effektiv, sikker og ansvarlig produksjon av
fisk – helt fra starten av.

## Rogn

Vi produserer genetisk startmateriale; fiskeegg med råsterk genetikk som gir en svært robust og
frisk fisk som yter godt.

## Stamfisk

Vi forvalter og utvikler den norske koden - det eldste vitenskapelige avlsprogrammet for atlantisk
laks og regnbueørret.

## Forskning

Avansert genomikk og banebrytende forskning på sykdomsresistens, vekst og et stadig mer bærekraftig
havbruk.

[AquaGen-rogna]

## Såkorn for livskraft

Rogna vår sikrer et ansvarlig, lønnsomt og bærekraftig oppdrett av atlantisk laks og fjordørret.
Produktene våre sørger for god ytelse og vekst hos fisken og oppfyller de strengeste kvalitetskrav
til sunn og velsmakende mat.

[ Våre arter og produkter ][12]

## Fra vitenskap til matfat hviler et stort ansvar.

Nøkkelen til å nå mange av **FNs bærekraftsmål **ligger i havet. Gjennom hele syklusen fra vitenskap
til matfat forplikter vi oss til en bærekraftig verdiskaping på den tredelte bunnlinjen; miljø,
samfunn og økonomi. God ytelse på én bunnlinje skal ikke gå på bekostning av god ytelse på en annen.
Gjennom en sikker produksjon og en sikker leveranse sørger vi for at oppdrettere alltid mottar et
genetisk startmateriale som er optimalisert for fisk, miljø og mennesker.

## Alt nytt starter med noe lite

Play Video

Alt nytt starter med noe lite. En dråpe, et frø, et egg. Troen på at noe lite kan bli starten på noe
mye større. Noe viktig. Noe som kan forandre verden. For hvem hadde trodd at en laks som svømte
lykkelig rundt i Nidelva for 50 år siden skulle bli stamfar til milliarder av fisk jorden rundt?
Vel, vi trodde det.

### **Personvernerklæring**

Personvernerklæringen handler om hvordan denne nettsiden samler inn og bruker informasjon om
besøkende. Erklæringen inneholder informasjon du har krav på når det samles inn opplysninger fra
nettstedet vårt, og generell informasjon om hvordan vi behandler personopplysninger. Juridisk eier
av nettsiden er behandlingsansvarlig for virksomhetens behandling av personopplysninger. Det er
frivillig for de som besøker nettsidene å oppgi personopplysninger i forbindelse med tjenester som å
motta nyhetsbrev og benytte del- og tipstjenesten. Behandlingsgrunnlaget er samtykke fra den
enkelte, med mindre annet er spesifisert.

#### **1. Webanalyse og informasjonskapsler (cookies)**

Som en viktig del av arbeidet med å lage et brukervennlig nettsted, ser vi på brukermønsteret til de
som besøker nettstedet. For å analysere informasjonen, bruker vi analyseverktøyet [Google
Analytics][18]. Google Analytics bruker informasjonskapsler/cookies (små tekstfiler som nettstedet
lagrer på brukerens datamaskin), som registrerer brukernes IP-adresse, og som gir informasjon om den
enkelte brukers bevegelser på nett. Eksempler på hva statistikken gir oss svar på er; hvor mange som
besøker ulike sider, hvor lenge besøket varer, hvilke nettsteder brukerne kommer fra og hvilke
nettlesere som benyttes. Ingen av informasjonskapslene gjør at vi kan knytte informasjon om din bruk
av nettstedet til deg som enkeltperson. Informasjonen som samles inn av Google Analytics, lagres på
Googles servere i USA. Mottatte opplysninger er underlagt [Googles retningslinjer for
personvern][19]. En IP-adresse er definert som en personopplysning fordi den kan spores tilbake til
en bestemt maskinvare og dermed til en enkeltperson. Vi bruker Google Analytics sin sporingskode som
[anonymiserer IP-adressen][20] før informasjonen lagres og bearbeides av Google. Dermed kan ikke den
lagrede IP-adressen brukes til å identifisere den enkelte brukeren.

#### **2. Søk**

Hvis nettsiden har søkefunksjon så lagrer informasjon om hvilke søkeord brukerne benytter i Google
Analytics. Formålet med lagringen er å gjøre informasjonstilbudet vårt bedre. Bruksmønsteret for søk
lagres i aggregert form. Det er bare søkeordet som lagres, og de kan ikke kobles til andre
opplysninger om brukerne, slik som til IP-adressene.

#### **3. Del/tips-tjenesten**

Funksjonen "Del med andre" kan brukes til å videresende lenker til nettstedet på e-post, eller til å
dele innholdet på sosiale nettsamfunn. Opplysninger om tips logges ikke hos oss, men brukes kun der
og da til å legge inn tipset hos nettsamfunnet. Vi kan imidlertid ikke garantere at nettsamfunnet
ikke logger disse opplysningene. Alle slike tjenester bør derfor brukes med vett. Dersom du benytter
e-postfunksjonen, bruker vi bare de oppgitte e-postadressene til å sende meldingen videre uten noen
form for lagring.

#### **4. Nyhetsbrev**

Nettsiden kan sende ut nyhetsbrev via epost hvis du har registrert deg for å motta dette. For at vi
skal kunne sende e-post må du registrere en e-postadresse. Mailchimp er databehandler for
nyhetsbrevet. E-postadressen lagres i en egen database, deles ikke med andre og slettes når du sier
opp abonnementet. E-postadressen slettes også om vi får tilbakemelding om at den ikke er aktiv.

#### **5. Påmelding, skjema**

Nettsiden kan ha skjema for påmelding, kontaktskjema eller andre skjema. Disse skjemaene er
tilgjengeliggjort for publikum for å utføre de oppgaver de er ment å gjøre. Påmeldingsskjema er for
at besøkende kan melde seg på eller registrere seg. Kontaktskjema er for at besøkende enkelt kan
sende en melding til nettsidens kontaktperson. Vi ber da om navnet på innsender og
kontaktinformasjon til denne. Personopplysninger vi mottar blir ikke benyttet til andre formål enn å
svare på henvendelsen. Skjema sendes som epost via Mailgun som tredjepartsløsning. Hele innsendelen
blir lagret hos Mailgun i 24 timer. Mellom 24 timer og 30 dager er det kun mailheader som blir
oppbevart før innsendelsen blir slettet etter 30 dager. Årsaken til denne lagringen er for å
bekrefte om eposter blir sendt fra nettsiden og videresendt til riktig mottaker. Når eposten er
mottatt av mottaker så er det opp til mottaker å avgjøre Databehandlingsbehovet av eposten.

#### **6. Side- og tjenestefunksjonalitet**

Det blir brukt informasjonskapsler i drift og presentasjon av data fra nettsteder. Slike
informasjonskapsler kan inneholde informasjon om språkkode for språk valgt av brukeren. Det kan være
informasjonskapsler med informasjon som støtter om lastbalanseringen av systemet slik at alle
brukere blir sikret en best mulig opplevelse. Ved tjenester som krever innlogging eller søk kan det
bli brukt informasjonskapsler som sikrer at tjenesten presenterer data til rett mottaker.

#### **7. Hvordan håndtere informasjonskapsler i din nettleser**

På [www.nettvett.no][21] kan du lese om hvordan du [stiller inn nettleseren for å godta/avvise
informasjonskapsler,][22] og få [tips til sikrere bruk av internett][23].

# BENEO – Together we contribute to better nutrition and health

The expectations regarding nutritional choices and functionalities of food have drastically grown
over the last decades.

BENEO is your global partner in catering to the [latest trends and developments in the food and feed
industry][124]. Together, we contribute to better nutrition and health. And with local branches all
over the world, you always have a competent expert to talk to. Just get in touch.

Consumers actively choose foods that contribute to their well-being. Even more, products that match
their individual lifestyles are on [trend][125]. As the demand for convenient and easy to prepare
food continues, the expectations on nutrition also continue to grow. To name just a few, these
include the [reduction of sugar][126] and fat without compromising on taste and texture, increased
dietary fibre intake, plus a need for [healthier weight][127] and [energy management][128].

# BENEO – Together we contribute to better nutrition and health

The expectations regarding nutritional choices and functionalities of food have drastically grown
over the last decades.

BENEO is your global partner in catering to the [latest trends and developments in the food and feed
industry][124]. Together, we contribute to better nutrition and health. And with local branches all
over the world, you always have a competent expert to talk to. Just get in touch.

Consumers actively choose foods that contribute to their well-being. Even more, products that match
their individual lifestyles are on [trend][125]. As the demand for convenient and easy to prepare
food continues, the expectations on nutrition also continue to grow. To name just a few, these
include the [reduction of sugar][126] and fat without compromising on taste and texture, increased
dietary fibre intake, plus a need for [healthier weight][127] and [energy management][128].

Farmers, breeders as well as livestock or pet owners on the other hand foster increasingly higher
expectations on the nutritional quality of their feed products. They expect targeted feed, aqua and
pet food that provides their animals with the right amount of nutrients.

BENEO’s [ingredients][129] can be applied to a wide variety of food applications: from beverages to
baby food, bakery, confectionery, cereals, soups and sauces. We also supply ingredients for
different kinds of [animal nutrition][130], ranging from cattle feed to cat food.

[Meatless hybrid]

## The next step in meat innovation is hybrid

Combining Meatless^{®} ingredients with meat can improve taste and texture, reduce costs and add
nutritional value.

# Creating a *more*
# *food secure* world

Our planet’s population is growing rapidly — and so is the need for more food. Already, 800 million
people go to bed hungry each night. As a food company to the world, Cargill is partnering with
farmers and customers to grow and produce more food with less impact, to move that food to store
shelves and family tables, and to nourish people for a more food secure world.

[Watch the video][52]

**GROW**

### [Meet the farmers building our food-secure world][53]

**MOVE**

### [Advancing decarbonization across the food supply chain][54]

**NOURISH**

### [Discover how we’re building resilient food systems][55]

## 2025 Annual Report

#### Connecting a food secure world

The food you eat has a story to tell. Because before you take that first bite, a global network of
hard-working people – spanning countries, cultures and skillsets – each did their part to grow, make
and move your meal from where it was grown to the fork in your hand. At Cargill, it’s our privilege
to facilitate the complex connections that make it all happen.

In Cargill’s 2025 Annual Report, we share how we’re strengthening ties between farmers, frontline
food workers and the customers we exist to serve. Learn how our collective efforts are helping
transform food and agriculture and connect a food secure world.

[Read the Report][56]

[2025 annual report feature image]

 

 

[2025 Impact report feature image]

## 2025 Impact Report

#### Building a more resilient food system

As a company that sits at the center of the global food system, Cargill plays a unique role in
connecting farmers, food producers, and consumers. This vantage point makes it clear that the future
of food depends on a system that is productive, sustainable, and resilient.

In Cargill’s 2025 Impact Report, we share how our strategy reflects this interconnected view — how
growing food impacts natural resources; how it moves from where it’s grown; and how we partner to
expand access to nutrition, improve farmer and community livelihoods, and accelerate our customers’
progress on sustainability.

Together, we’re working to build a stronger, more sustainable food system that can nourish the world
for generations to come.

[Read the Report][57]

 

 

## Our purpose

#### To nourish the world in a safe, responsible and sustainable way

Sitting at the heart of the global supply chain, we join farmers, ranchers, manufacturers,
foodservice customers and retailers in sourcing, making and delivering products that are vital for
living.

Every day, our 155K+ team members come to work:
* Driven to improve lives through food, nutrition and health
* Looking for ways to innovate with purpose
* Committed to nourishing our growing world by providing access to life’s essentials

This is how we create new opportunities for our customers to grow, communities to prosper and
consumers to live well.

[Read about Cargill][58]

[Our purpose]

 

 

 

 

## People

 

With 155K+ colleagues in 70 countries, we work as a global network to bring together the people,
ideas and resources that can nourish lives around the world.

[Careers][59]

## Products

 

Partnering across the supply chain, we bring food, ingredients, agricultural solutions and
industrial products to meet customers’ ever-evolving needs.

[Products & Services][60]

## Planet

 

From small family farms to global shipping lanes, we work every day to bring new sustainable
practices, reduce our impact on the planet and take care of people.

[Sustainability][61]

# Creating a *more*
# *food secure* world

Our planet’s population is growing rapidly — and so is the need for more food. Already, 800 million
people go to bed hungry each night. As a food company to the world, Cargill is partnering with
farmers and customers to grow and produce more food with less impact, to move that food to store
shelves and family tables, and to nourish people for a more food secure world.

[Watch the video][52]

**GROW**

### [Meet the farmers building our food-secure world][53]

**MOVE**

### [Advancing decarbonization across the food supply chain][54]

**NOURISH**

### [Discover how we’re building resilient food systems][55]

## 2025 Annual Report

#### Connecting a food secure world

The food you eat has a story to tell. Because before you take that first bite, a global network of
hard-working people – spanning countries, cultures and skillsets – each did their part to grow, make
and move your meal from where it was grown to the fork in your hand. At Cargill, it’s our privilege
to facilitate the complex connections that make it all happen.

In Cargill’s 2025 Annual Report, we share how we’re strengthening ties between farmers, frontline
food workers and the customers we exist to serve. Learn how our collective efforts are helping
transform food and agriculture and connect a food secure world.

[Read the Report][56]

[2025 annual report feature image]

 

 

[2025 Impact report feature image]

## 2025 Impact Report

#### Building a more resilient food system

As a company that sits at the center of the global food system, Cargill plays a unique role in
connecting farmers, food producers, and consumers. This vantage point makes it clear that the future
of food depends on a system that is productive, sustainable, and resilient.

In Cargill’s 2025 Impact Report, we share how our strategy reflects this interconnected view — how
growing food impacts natural resources; how it moves from where it’s grown; and how we partner to
expand access to nutrition, improve farmer and community livelihoods, and accelerate our customers’
progress on sustainability.

Together, we’re working to build a stronger, more sustainable food system that can nourish the world
for generations to come.

[Read the Report][57]

 

 

## Our purpose

#### To nourish the world in a safe, responsible and sustainable way

Sitting at the heart of the global supply chain, we join farmers, ranchers, manufacturers,
foodservice customers and retailers in sourcing, making and delivering products that are vital for
living.

Every day, our 155K+ team members come to work:
* Driven to improve lives through food, nutrition and health
* Looking for ways to innovate with purpose
* Committed to nourishing our growing world by providing access to life’s essentials

This is how we create new opportunities for our customers to grow, communities to prosper and
consumers to live well.

[Read about Cargill][58]

[Our purpose]

 

 

 

 

## People

 

With 155K+ colleagues in 70 countries, we work as a global network to bring together the people,
ideas and resources that can nourish lives around the world.

[Careers][59]

## Products

 

Partnering across the supply chain, we bring food, ingredients, agricultural solutions and
industrial products to meet customers’ ever-evolving needs.

[Products & Services][60]

## Planet

 

From small family farms to global shipping lanes, we work every day to bring new sustainable
practices, reduce our impact on the planet and take care of people.

[Sustainability][61]

What are others saying about our impact? With operations in 70 countries, Cargill and our customers

# Our purpose

# Feeding the Future

Nutreco is a leading animal nutrition company offering solutions that go beyond nutrition – we
provide best-in-class advice and technology to help our customers produce more feed in a sustainable
way to feed the growing population.

## Nutreco's story 

Imagine a baby born in 2025. Digital native, world citizen, modern human. And like all the other 8,3
billion humans on the earth today (2026), an omnivore able to choose a varied diet, with protein an
important daily part. At Nutreco, our business is built around supporting the people who produce
this healthy protein.

[Read our story][56]

  We are working across the value chain to create a more sustainable food system, and a better
  future for our industry and our planet.

  We believe in three core elements to future success: strategy execution, innovation, and
  competence of our people. Our values; Trust, Inclusion,  Integrity, Curiosity and Passion are
  supportive of those three core elements.

# Our purpose

# Feeding the Future

Nutreco is a leading animal nutrition company offering solutions that go beyond nutrition – we
provide best-in-class advice and technology to help our customers produce more feed in a sustainable
way to feed the growing population.

## Nutreco's story 

Imagine a baby born in 2025. Digital native, world citizen, modern human. And like all the other 8,3
billion humans on the earth today (2026), an omnivore able to choose a varied diet, with protein an
important daily part. At Nutreco, our business is built around supporting the people who produce
this healthy protein.

[Read our story][56]

## Discover who we are in the video below

### Who we are
* ## Purpose, vision & values
  
  Everything we do as a company is driven by our purpose, vision and values.
  
  [ Read more ][57]
* ## Sustainability
  
  We are working across the value chain to create a more sustainable food system, and a better
  future for our industry and our planet.
  
  [ Read more ][58]
* ## People & careers
  
  We believe in three core elements to future success: strategy execution, innovation, and
  competence of our people. Our values; Trust, Inclusion,  Integrity, Curiosity and Passion are
  supportive of those three core elements. 
  
  [ Read more ][59]

Welcome to Ridley

### Navigating the food production challenges of today and tomorrow.

##### **Ridley’s comprehensive fertiliser and feed solutions.
##### **

As Australia’s leading provider of premium quality, high-performance nutrition solutions from soil
to livestock, we believe smart, integrated approaches are pivotal to solving the food production
challenges of today and tomorrow. Our integrated capability and scale spans fertiliser expertise,
production and sourcing of raw materials, ingredient recovery, specialised nutrition formulation,
feed manufacturing and on-ground sales support.

FERTILISERS STAKEHOLDER UPDATE

### Supporting Australian agriculture in challenging times.

##### Incitec Pivot Fertilisers: keeping growers informed.

As a consequence of the Middle East conflict, Australia’s urea fertiliser supply has been
significantly impacted. Ridley, as the owner of Incitec Pivot, would like to provide a snapshot of
actions taken to date, and our current views on availability of fertilisers, to assist our customers
to make informed decisions in a period of uncertainty. In doing so, we aim to help farmers and their
advisors make the best possible decisions for the season ahead.

[ View July Stakeholder Update ][58] [ View June Stakeholder Update ][59]

Welcome to Ridley

### Navigating the food production challenges of today and tomorrow.

##### **Ridley’s comprehensive fertiliser and feed solutions.
##### **

As Australia’s leading provider of premium quality, high-performance nutrition solutions from soil
to livestock, we believe smart, integrated approaches are pivotal to solving the food production
challenges of today and tomorrow. Our integrated capability and scale spans fertiliser expertise,
production and sourcing of raw materials, ingredient recovery, specialised nutrition formulation,
feed manufacturing and on-ground sales support.

FERTILISERS STAKEHOLDER UPDATE

### Supporting Australian agriculture in challenging times.

##### Incitec Pivot Fertilisers: keeping growers informed.

As a consequence of the Middle East conflict, Australia’s urea fertiliser supply has been
significantly impacted. Ridley, as the owner of Incitec Pivot, would like to provide a snapshot of
actions taken to date, and our current views on availability of fertilisers, to assist our customers
to make informed decisions in a period of uncertainty. In doing so, we aim to help farmers and their
advisors make the best possible decisions for the season ahead.

[ View July Stakeholder Update ][58] [ View June Stakeholder Update ][59]

# About us.

Founded in 2013, AFS Global FZ-LLC is a UAE-based animal nutrition company committed to delivering
sustainable, high-quality feed ingredients. From our facility in Ras Al Khaimah, we grow fresh
hydroponic barley fodder using minimal water and no soil. In parallel, we supply globally-sourced
Marine, Animal and Plant Protein Meals,as well as crude fish oil for feed mills and aquaculture
producers across the world.



We manage clients professionally and effectively. Our involvement spans the entire value chain, from
production and quality control to sales, logistics, and exports.



# Core Values.

Equality: We treat all humans as equals and uplift our communities.

Diligence: Daily efficiency is our mantra aka Accurate Fast Service.

Integrity: We negotiate with integrity.

Respect: Clients & suppliers are treated with respect and professionalism.

Honesty: We uphold honesty and transparency in all dealings.

# Our Vision.

Sustainability: We strive to contribute to sustainable agricultural practices.



Growth: We seek continuous growth, offering turnkey solutions and trading opportunities.



AI: We strive to embrace artificial intelligence to streamline our company ensuring more cost
effective products and services. 

# Have a look at our History and Future plans.

### 2013

Executing sales and exports for AST Group in Angola for Fishmeal and Fish Oil.

### 2015

Exporting Frozen fish out of Angola for the first time in 40years reaching 1000 metric tons per
month.



### 2016

Implementing and managing exports for Oceana Group in Tombwa, Angola.

### 2017

Supercargo status to grade quality of export frozen fish on behalf of client - JMarr.

### 2018

Open Dry Port in Namibe, Angola - 4000sqm Warehouse with outside container storage.

### 2020

Taking control of fishmeal production at RJ Industrial, Tombwa, Angola.

Start Carne Butchery in South Africa, expanded later in the year to Tombwa, Angola.

### 2021

Establish Chicken feed factory to produce for local market in Angola.

Start sales and exports of fishmeal for other clients outside AST Group in Namibia.

Open Sales Office in Busan, South Korea.

Built and launched pilot Aquaponic system in Angola - Tilapia and Tomato.

### 2023

Establish Ras Al Khaimah office in the UAE.

### 2024

Establish Hydroponic Barley growing unit in RAK, UAE.

Launched Aravian Ostrich Leather handbags in the UAE.

### 2026

Launch "OMEGA GOLD" Animal Nutrition Supplement in South Africa.

Partner with large European Distributor to add animal and plant proteins to our product list -
Serving Middle East, North Africa and South Korean markets.

### Future Plans in the UAE

Hydroponic production of Algae.

Hydroponic production of Seaweed.

Blending and distributing fishmeal.

Pelletizing fishmeal and other ingredients for animal conditioning

Refining Oil for animal and human consumption.

Extracting Algae Omega3 oil.



###### Ras Al Khaimah, United Arab Emirates

© 2026 

All Rights Reserved | AFS Global FZ-LLC

## Aquaculture Natural Solutions

## Let's Go Towards More Natural Solutions

ANS brings a fresh perspective to the seafood industry, combining deep expertise with a
forward-thinking approach to help you grow your business and maximize your investment.
Guided by our core values: Quality, Safety, and Sustainability, we empower companies to refine their
strategies in aquaculture and the pet food sector, connecting them with the right partners and
solutions to enhance performance.
Additionally, ANS offers a carefully curated selection of premium ingredients, including Fish
Hydrolysates and High Omega-3 Fish Oils, meeting the highest industry standards.
Let us help you navigate the market with confidence and purpose.

## About us

## A fully independent consulting company focused on Solutions for the Feed industry

Created in 2011, ANS is a fully independent consulting company.
We work hard to provide you the best services and products.
Dominique Corlay (Diploma of Engineer and MSc), founder of ANS, has a long experience in the
aquaculture and feed industry at various positions from research to management of business units.

## آکوافید پلاس

### درخشش کیفیت، توازنِ طبیعت

آکوافید پلاس یک برند نوآور در صنعت خوراک آبزیان است که با بهره‌گیری از متخصصان با تجربه در زمینه تغذیه
آبزیان، کارکنان مجرب، تجهیزات پیشرفته و خدمات نوین به منظور برآورد نیازها و چالش های روز آبزی پروری
تاسیس شده است و به دنبال ایجاد تحول در این حوزه می باشد. بنیان گذاران آکوافید پلاس با بیش از ۲۰ سال
تجربه در زمینه آبزی پروری و شناخت دقیق از نیازهای پرورش‌دهندگان تصمیم به ایجاد این برند گرفتند. این
برند جدید با ارائه محصولات با کیفیت به سرعت جایگاه خود را در صنعت آبزی پروری تثبیت کرده است و هم
اکنون یکی از گزینه های محبوب در بین پرورش دهندگان می باشد.

[ درباره آکوافید پلاس ][97]
[ ][98]
[پشتیبانی فنی][پشتیبانی فنی]

## پشتیبانی تخصصی و جامع مشتریان

ما در آکوافید پلاس، بر این باوریم که تغذیه بهینه و مدیریت علمی دو رکن اساسی در آبزی‌پروری مدرن هستند.
به همین دلیل، ما خدمات ویژه‌ای را برای آبزی پروران از جمله توصیه‌های تخصصی در زمینه مدیریت تغذیه و
راهکارهای بهینه‌سازی مزارع ارائه می دهیم. تیم کارشناسان ما با مشاوره ­های تخصصی در مراحل مختلف تولید
به پرورش ­دهندگان کمک می­کند تا شاخص ­های کلیدی همچون کاهش ضریب تبدیل خوراک (FCR)، پایش کیفیت آب و
افزایش راندمان تولید را با دقت رصد و مدیریت کنند. علاوه براین، ما با ارائه کارگاه‌های آموزشی و
مشاوره‌های میدانی، این شرایط را فراهم می­کنیم تا پرورش‌دهندگان بتوانند از جدیدترین روش‌های صنعت آبزی­
پروری بهره‌مند شوند و در عین حال میزان بهره‌وری و سودآوری خود را افزایش دهند.

## دریافت تندیس و لوح تقدیر در نمایشگاه بین‌المللی IFEX 2024

## تاریخ انتشار : ۲۴ آذر ۱۴۰۳

**به گزارش روابط عمومی برند خوراک آبزیان آکوافیدپلاس، **برند خوراک آبزیان آکوافیدپلاس در هشتمین
نمایشگاه بین‌المللی شیلات، آبزیان، ماهیگیری، غذاهای دریایی و صنایع وابسته که از ۱۳ تا ۱۶ آذرماه ۱۴۰۳
در محل دائمی نمایشگاه‌های بین‌المللی تهران برگزار شد، موفق به دریافت تندیس و لوح تقدیر به عنوان برترین
غرفه نمایشگاه شد.    بیشتر…

## رونمایی از کتاب «تشخیص و کاربرد سونوگرافی در مدیریت مولدین خاویاری»

## تاریخ انتشار : ۱۵ آذر ۱۴۰۳

کتاب پیشگام «تشخیص و کاربرد سونوگرافی در مدیریت مولدین خاویاری» در نمایشگاه بین‌المللی آبزیان رونمایی
شد.   بیشتر…

## هشتمین نمایشگاه بین‌المللی صنعت شیلات و آبزیان تهران افتتاح شد

## تاریخ انتشار : ۱۳ آذر ۱۴۰۳

** **
مراسم افتتاحیه **هشتمین نمایشگاه بین‌المللی شیلات، آبزیان و صنایع وابسته**** (IFEX 2024)** امروز
**۱۳**** آذر ****۱۴۰۳**با حضور **سید حسین حسینی**، معاون وزیر و رئیس سازمان شیلات ایران و جمعی از
مقامات داخلی و خارجی در محل دائمی نمایشگاه‌های بین‌المللی تهران برگزار شد.   بیشتر…

## آکوافیدپلاس در نمایشگاه بین‌ المللی آبزیان ایفکس ۲۰۲۴ تهران حضور می‌یابد

## آکوافید پلاس

### درخشش کیفیت، توازنِ طبیعت

آکوافید پلاس یک برند نوآور در صنعت خوراک آبزیان است که با بهره‌گیری از متخصصان با تجربه در زمینه تغذیه
آبزیان، کارکنان مجرب، تجهیزات پیشرفته و خدمات نوین به منظور برآورد نیازها و چالش های روز آبزی پروری
تاسیس شده است و به دنبال ایجاد تحول در این حوزه می باشد. بنیان گذاران آکوافید پلاس با بیش از ۲۰ سال
تجربه در زمینه آبزی پروری و شناخت دقیق از نیازهای پرورش‌دهندگان تصمیم به ایجاد این برند گرفتند. این
برند جدید با ارائه محصولات با کیفیت به سرعت جایگاه خود را در صنعت آبزی پروری تثبیت کرده است و هم
اکنون یکی از گزینه های محبوب در بین پرورش دهندگان می باشد.

[ درباره آکوافید پلاس ][97]
[ ][98]
[پشتیبانی فنی][پشتیبانی فنی]

## پشتیبانی تخصصی و جامع مشتریان

ما در آکوافید پلاس، بر این باوریم که تغذیه بهینه و مدیریت علمی دو رکن اساسی در آبزی‌پروری مدرن هستند.
به همین دلیل، ما خدمات ویژه‌ای را برای آبزی پروران از جمله توصیه‌های تخصصی در زمینه مدیریت تغذیه و
راهکارهای بهینه‌سازی مزارع ارائه می دهیم. تیم کارشناسان ما با مشاوره ­های تخصصی در مراحل مختلف تولید
به پرورش ­دهندگان کمک می­کند تا شاخص ­های کلیدی همچون کاهش ضریب تبدیل خوراک (FCR)، پایش کیفیت آب و
افزایش راندمان تولید را با دقت رصد و مدیریت کنند. علاوه براین، ما با ارائه کارگاه‌های آموزشی و
مشاوره‌های میدانی، این شرایط را فراهم می­کنیم تا پرورش‌دهندگان بتوانند از جدیدترین روش‌های صنعت آبزی­
پروری بهره‌مند شوند و در عین حال میزان بهره‌وری و سودآوری خود را افزایش دهند.

## آکوافید پلاس

### درخشش کیفیت، توازنِ طبیعت

آکوافید پلاس یک برند نوآور در صنعت خوراک آبزیان است که با بهره‌گیری از متخصصان با تجربه در زمینه تغذیه
آبزیان، کارکنان مجرب، تجهیزات پیشرفته و خدمات نوین به منظور برآورد نیازها و چالش های روز آبزی پروری
تاسیس شده است و به دنبال ایجاد تحول در این حوزه می باشد. بنیان گذاران آکوافید پلاس با بیش از ۲۰ سال
تجربه در زمینه آبزی پروری و شناخت دقیق از نیازهای پرورش‌دهندگان تصمیم به ایجاد این برند گرفتند. این
برند جدید با ارائه محصولات با کیفیت به سرعت جایگاه خود را در صنعت آبزی پروری تثبیت کرده است و هم
اکنون یکی از گزینه های محبوب در بین پرورش دهندگان می باشد.

[ درباره آکوافید پلاس ][97]

## پشتیبانی تخصصی و جامع مشتریان

ما در آکوافید پلاس، بر این باوریم که تغذیه بهینه و مدیریت علمی دو رکن اساسی در آبزی‌پروری مدرن هستند.
به همین دلیل، ما خدمات ویژه‌ای را برای آبزی پروران از جمله توصیه‌های تخصصی در زمینه مدیریت تغذیه و
راهکارهای بهینه‌سازی مزارع ارائه می دهیم. تیم کارشناسان ما با مشاوره ­های تخصصی در مراحل مختلف تولید
به پرورش ­دهندگان کمک می­کند تا شاخص ­های کلیدی همچون کاهش ضریب تبدیل خوراک (FCR)، پایش کیفیت آب و
افزایش راندمان تولید را با دقت رصد و مدیریت کنند. علاوه براین، ما با ارائه کارگاه‌های آموزشی و
مشاوره‌های میدانی، این شرایط را فراهم می­کنیم تا پرورش‌دهندگان بتوانند از جدیدترین روش‌های صنعت آبزی­
پروری بهره‌مند شوند و در عین حال میزان بهره‌وری و سودآوری خود را افزایش دهند.

### ABOUT THE INSTITUTE

Indian Council of Agricultural Research (ICAR), New Delhi, under the Ministry of Agriculture,
Government of India established the Central Institute of Brackishwater Aquaculture (CIBA) on
01-04-1987. The Central Institute of Brackishwater Aquaculture serves as the nodal agency for the
development of brackishwater aquaculture in the country. The Headquarters of the Institute is
located at Chennai with an experimental field station at Muttukadu (MES), about 30 km south of
Chennai.

machine, puff snack machine, energy granola bar machine and support equipment. Now Darin machines
have been exported to more than 100 countries of the world. Keeping automation, quality and service
in mind, always based on the diverse needs of customers, Darin will be dedicated to providing
clients with satified product and full life after sales service.

## We look forward to welcoming you in Riga in June 2025.

Registration has ended

[Registration Closed][32]

## Explore Riga’s charm

In Riga, medieval charm meets modern vibrancy. Stroll through cobblestone streets and admire
stunning Art Nouveau architecture. Explore the Old Town, a UNESCO World Heritage site, with its
historical landmarks like Riga Cathedral and St. Peter’s Church.

Visit the bustling Central Market for local delicacies and handmade crafts. At night, enjoy the
city’s lively nightlife with bars, clubs, and live music venues. Don’t miss the views along the
Daugava River.

Riga’s mix of old-world elegance and contemporary coolness offers an unforgettable experience for
history buffs, architecture enthusiasts, and adventurers alike.

[About Riga][33]

# Ingredients for a sustainable food chain

**Transforming circular economy side streams into planet friendly mycoprotein.**

This is our recipe for a sustainable food system that enables healthy and tasty diets for all.

## Future-proof protein

[PEKILO® products][22]

PEKILO® is a highly nutritious mycoprotein with neutral taste and color. As a versatile and
sustainable source of nutrients, PEKILO® makes an ideal drop-in ingredient for aquafeed, pet food,
and food production.

Neutral taste and color
Highly nutritious & rich in complete protein
Easy to use drop-in ingredient
Fewer GHG emissions, less water and land needed compared to animal and soy protein
[PEKILO® products][23]

PEKILO® mycoprotein is an ideal drop-in ingredient for the food industry seeking a sustainable
protein source with neutral taste and color. PEKILO® contains up to 55% of protein, a balanced amino
acid profile, omega-6 and 35% of fiber. Its versatility, nutritional value and functionalities make
it one of a kind.

[Learn more about PEKILO® for food][24]

PEKILO® for aquafeed is an easy-to-use drop-in ingredient containing 65% crude protein as well as
beta-glucan and nucleotides. Fit for formulation and faster growth, PEKILO® is paving the way for
more sustainably farmed fish.

[Learn more about PEKILO®Aqua][25]

PEKILO® for pet food is a high-protein, animal-free drop-in ingredient. Sustainably produced,
PEKILO® is the natural choice for all pet food producers looking to offer planet friendly dietary
options.

[Learn more about PEKILO®Pet][26]
Why Fungi?

## Flora, fauna… and funga!

Fungi have been a natural part of the human diet for millennia, but still offer much untapped
potential. Today, we derive our protein from plants or animals. Fungi form a kingdom completely
apart, being neither plants nor animals. They can offer us the best of both worlds and more!

Fungal mycoprotein matches the nutritional quality of animal protein. Fungi create completely new
protein, distinguishing them from animals that simply convert plant-derived protein.

[Learn more about us][27]

The production of mycoprotein is sustainable and ethical like that of plant proteins – and even
better. Producing PEKILO® mycoprotein requires no new agricultural land, minimal water, leads to no
nutrient runoff and thus has a very low environmental footprint.

[Learn more about us][28]
More than 70%

## less GHG emissions

compared to imported soy protein. Our mycoprotein is sustainably produced from side streams using
minimal water and land.

[Learn more about our impact][29]
est.1975

## Tried and tested.

Alternative protein solutions are nothing new to us. PEKILO® mycoprotein has been in industrial
production already during 1975–1991. With a production process optimised for efficiency,
applications are only limited by imagination.

[Learn more about our technology][30]

# We Upgrade Extruders.

#### It's that simple.

[ See our solutions ][39]

## SIMPLY PUT, WE OPTIMIZE EXTRUSION LINES

At Ever Extruder, we help pet food and aquafeed manufacturers maximize Overall Equipment
Effectiveness (OEE) by upgrading extruders with solutions that outperform those from OEMs and other
aftermarket suppliers.

###### Our Products

#### Pet food processing, perfected

## [Density Control System ❯][40]

An end of extruder process technology that allows adjustment in the extruder pressure, mechanical
energy, and residence time. Integrated with die relief to provide operator safety and extrusion
sanitation.

## [Stabilization System ❯][41]

Includes precision shaft support, carriage support, and laser alignment for smooth, steady operation
at peak speeds.

## [Carbide Die Plates ❯][42]

Carbide protection on die cavities ensures consistent product quality by maintaining cavity size and
shape for up to 15,000 tons.

## [Carbide Screws ❯][43]

Carbide protection on screw flighting maintains optimum part performance for up to 30,000 hours.

## [Clad Liners ❯][44]

Carbide protection on liner ribbing maintains optimum part performance for up to 30,000 hours.

## [Cutting System ❯][45]

One-bolt, self-tensioned, fixed-blade cutting system installs in seconds and last for up to 16,000
tons.

## [Cutting System ❯][46]

One-bolt, self-tensioned, fixed-blade cutting system installs in seconds and last for up to 16,000
tons.

## [Carbide Die Plates ❯][47]

Carbide protection on die cavities ensures consistent product quality by maintaining cavity size and
shape for up to 15,000 tons.

## [Carbide Screws ❯][48]

Carbide protection on screw flighting maintains optimum part performance for up to 30,000 hours.

## [Clad Liners ❯][49]

Carbide protection on liner ribbing maintains optimum part performance for up to 30,000 hours.

## [Density Control System ❯][50]

An end of extruder process technology that allows adjustment in the extruder pressure, mechanical
energy, and residence time. Integrated with die relief to provide operator safety and extrusion
sanitation.

## [Stabilization System ❯][51]

Includes precision shaft support, carriage support, and laser alignment for smooth, steady operation
at peak speeds.

## WE IMPROVE WHAT MATTERS MOST

## PERFORMANCE

Our solutions keep extruders running at top capacity and performance, ensuring consistently high
throughputs. By optimizing wear parts and enhancing stability, we eliminate unnecessary stops and
changeovers.

## QUALITY

By maintaining critical geometry, our wear parts ensure consistent processing parameters and uniform
final product. Our solutions keep product quality controlled, consistent, and meeting specification,
without compromising capacity.

## AVAILABILITY

Our durable parts ensure every machine can run without maintenance intervention for longer,
minimizing unplanned and planned maintenance stops.

[ Read the case studies ][53]

## Always upgrading extrusion

By enhancing extruder performance, quality, and availability, our equipment keeps production running
with higher throughputs, consistent quality, and minimal downtime throughout the entire lifetime of
the parts—ensuring every manufacturing minute is truly productive.

We are passionate about finding and improving production and equipment bottlenecks, which drives us
to truly understand our customers’ challenges. This commitment extends into long-term partnerships,
where we serve as a source of continuous improvement by always upgrading extrusion.

[ About ever extruder ][54]

#### Partners in better products, better production

From full extruder rebuilds, to barrel refurbishing, to cutter blade sharpening, Ever Extruder

About Freshdi
Freshdi is a global B2B marketplace powered by AI.By integrating AI across the entire journey,
Freshdi enables suppliers and buyers worldwide to connect quickly, easily, and reliably - in just
only three steps: listing products, smart matching & trade connecting.
What makes Freshdi different?
Unlike traditional B2B platforms, Freshdi is built as an AI-driven marketplace, optimized for global
sourcing and export success in the digital age.
What documents are needed for the verified badge?
To earn the Verified Badge on Freshdi, submit one of the following: Business Registration
Certificate, Tax Registration Document, or Official Address Proof. Verification boosts your
credibility and attracts more buyer inquiries. [View more][1]
How can I improve my chances of finding buyers?
To enhance the efficiency of finding and connecting with buyers, list your products, complete
verification, send quotations, respond quickly to inquiries, and connect with buyers on the HOT and
NEW tab. Building global trade relationships takes consistent effort - we recommend committing at
least 4 months and investing in a Premium profile to stand out. [View more][2]
Are the buyers and suppliers listed here trustworthy?
Freshdi filters out suspicious profiles through verification services, but we are not a verification
agency. Users should still conduct independent checks and use trusted sources like embassies or
third-party agencies. Face-to-face meetings are highly recommended to reduce risks. [View more][3]
What are the benefits of the Premium Plan?
The Premium Plan helps you scale faster and connect with more serious buyers: stay on top of search
results, get fast access to inquiries, build trust with a detailed profile and product portfolio,
appear on the homepage and buyer emails, and stand out as a Premium Supplier. [View more][4]

increasing brand awareness for the Best Aquaculture Practices (BAP) label in key markets. Whether
you're a retailer, food service company or BAP-certified producer, sign up below to get involved.

GSA is pleased to announce the appointment of Libby Woodhatch, Executive Chair of MarinTrust, and
Jeremy Woodrow, Executive Director of the Alaska Seafood Marketing Institute (ASMI), to its Board of
Directors.

[ Read our blog ][51]

SeaMade Kelp Bar project at the University of New England, featuring student CEO Jayden Schoppee and
Director Cameron Wake.

male-dominated institutions limiting their opportunities.

Registration for the 2026 Summit is open! Join us in Bangkok, Thailand with seafood leaders and the
leaders of tomorrow for candid discussions about the future of the seafood industry.

[ Connect with the industry ][54]

## GSA Advances Responsible Seafood Practices Worldwide

[Image for article: Seafood You Can Trust: GSA's 2026 Consumer Campaign]

### Seafood You Can Trust: GSA's 2026 Consumer Campaign

GSA's upcoming campaign, Seafood You Can Trust, will be launching in early 2026, with the goal of
increasing brand awareness for the Best Aquaculture Practices (BAP) label in key markets. Whether
you're a retailer, food service company or BAP-certified producer, sign up below to get involved.

[ Join the campaign ][50]
[Image for article: Global Seafood Alliance Welcomes Libby Woodhatch and Jeremy Woodrow to Board of
Directors]

Read

### Global Seafood Alliance Welcomes Libby Woodhatch and Jeremy Woodrow to Board of Directors

GSA is pleased to announce the appointment of Libby Woodhatch, Executive Chair of MarinTrust, and
Jeremy Woodrow, Executive Director of the Alaska Seafood Marketing Institute (ASMI), to its Board of
Directors.

[ Read our blog ][51]
[Image for article: From Kelp to Classroom: Building a Student-Led Aquaculture Business]

Listen

### From Kelp to Classroom: Building a Student-Led Aquaculture Business

In this episode, we explore how aquaculture, entrepreneurship, and education intersect through the
SeaMade Kelp Bar project at the University of New England, featuring student CEO Jayden Schoppee and
Director Cameron Wake.

[ Listen to Aquademia ][52]
[Image for article: ‘Women’s work keeps fisheries alive’: How women in Japan are slowly breaking
barriers in a male-dominated industry]

Explore

### ‘Women’s work keeps fisheries alive’: How women in Japan are slowly breaking barriers in a
### male-dominated industry

Women are playing a growing role in fisheries in Japan despite traditional gender norms and
male-dominated institutions limiting their opportunities.

[ Explore the Advocate ][53]
[Image for article: Connect at the Summit]

Connect

### Connect at the Summit

Registration for the 2026 Summit is open! Join us in Bangkok, Thailand with seafood leaders and the
leaders of tomorrow for candid discussions about the future of the seafood industry.

[ Connect with the industry ][54]
[Image for article: Make an Impact]

Join

### Make an Impact

Contribute to our work and align with our values by becoming a member. Available at individual and
corporate levels, GSA Membership is an impactful contribution that helps to ensure a more
responsible seafood supply chain.

[ Join GSA Today! ][55]

A world that embraces the role of responsible seafood in meeting global nutrition needs.

The Global Seafood Alliance (GSA) is an international nongovernmental organization dedicated to
advancing responsible seafood practices through education, advocacy and third-party assurances.

# Join The Seafood Business Revolution

## InterFishMarket is the digital platform to build & boost your global seafood business. Buy & sell
## your seafood products online through the IFM marketplace and enjoy all the related services &
## products that IFM offers including the comfort & added value that all transactions are insured -
## and shortly - all transactions can also be easily financed.

[FIND OUT MORE][12]

## About InterFishMarket

### It's a B2B marketplace dedicated to the seafood industry and allows professionals to:
* Promote your company, your products and images world-wide.
* Insure every purchase and sale transaction–no risk of insolvency.
* Finance any purchase or sale transactions when needed. Up to +60 day payment options available.
* Manage all invoices and payments from one platform allowing you to save time and effort.
* Grow & expand your business. Meet new customers and create new business opportunities.

## Furthermore, IFM can offer Members financial services that will allow you to choose:

## When you buy

**We pay your supplier** and you choose when to pay **IFM**

+07 days from the due date of the invoice

+15 days from the due date of the invoice

+30 days from the due date of the invoice

+45 days from the due date of the invoice

+60 days from the due date of the invoice

## When you sell

**Receive your money directly from** **IFM** whenever you prefer:

within
48h from the delivery of the goods

on the exact due date of you invoice

## Are you a professional in the SEAFOOD industry? IFM is your new hub for everything Seafood!

InterFishMarket has been developed to service the business- to-business seafood sector. Producers,
Farmers, Wholesalers, Distributors, Supermarket Processors, etc... just to get started!

[FIND OUT MORE][13]

## Some numbers about
## InterFishMarket

Nationalities using IFM

Companies registered

KGS Traded

Transactions

## How will InterFishMarket provide funding for your transactions?

Our Marketplace acts as a central counterpart in all transactions so we can immediately pay your
sales and further defer your purchases using different financing solutions available through IFM and
thus eliminating the risk of insolvency for your company.

## Who is it for?

Are you a seafood industry professional working in any of the following categories?

#### [Producers/Farmers][14]

#### [Wholesalers/Distributors][15]

#### [Retailers/Supermarket Operators][16]

#### [Processors/Industry][17]

## [Start using InterFishMarket now!][18]

## IFM is backed by a team of professionals from the seafood & finance sectors with a combined
## experience of over 100 years

InterFishMarket was created by professionals, for professionals. Professionals just like you who
interact daily with the needs, issues and deliverables of the seafood industry.

[FIND OUT MORE][19]

## Trading system & Marketplace

### InterFishMarket is a **neutral marketplace** and acts as an intermediary to all transactions and
### **does not take risk positions; the system works like the most established e-commerce
### platforms.**
### 
### Our goal is to facilitate exchange activities in a transparent and efficient way between buyers
### and sellers all over the world, while offering both parties **access to financial services like
### insurance and financing.**
### 
### It is possible to execute transactions in two ways:

## Online Trading – Live Market
* Enter your sales or purchase order.
* Receive offers and close transactions on the platform.
* Enjoy the insurance and financial benefits that IFM offers you.

## Offline Trading – OTC Trade
* Close your offline sales (as you do every day on the phone, e-mail or Skype).
* Register your Trade on the IFM platform.
* Enjoy the insurance and financial benefits that IFM offers you.

## Benefits

#### [Smart Contract][20]

Sign legally binding sale and purchase agreements directly on the Marketplace.

#### [Certified Documents][21]

Always have the certainty of sending and receiving sales documents such as invoice, packing list or
signed CMR.

#### [Save Time][22]

Expiring invoices warnings and automated payment reminders, do not waste your time to track
payments, we'll take care of everything!


#### [Insurance Claims][23]

Do you have trouble with a payment?
No problem, no legal fulfillment, no document required: you just have to click, we do the job.

#### [Min. Insurance Cost][24]

IFM manages the insurance policy and our Marketplace doesn’t require any data for insurance
purposes. You pay only if you use the service, not on an expected result.

#### [Service Flexibility][25]

You can change the financial product requested at any time or even cancel it.

## Testimonials

I use IFM platform for my trades, it’s easy to use and full of useful too

## How much does it cost to use our platform?

### FREE MEMBERSHIP
* **Included Functions:**
* Offer & Demand
* Product placement
* Personal dashboard with document management
* Live Market
* OTC Trade
* Access to the global marketplace
* Credit insurance
* Financial services
* Guaranteed Support & Helpline
* Product marketing

[THE ACCOUNT IS FREE!][26]

## Additional benefits:
* Subscription: It's FREE
* No Fees or Commissions: Only if you sell and / or buy, you will be charged a small commission
  based on the weight exchanged (you can consult the commissions table when you first access the
  platform).
* Try it: Sign up today and access the Marketplace for free. See how the Marketplace works, products
  and services offered and how it can increase your business.

## FAQ

## Find the Answers Here
* How much does it cost?
  
  Subscribe for free, you will pay only and if you sell or buy, contact us for details.
* How does the insurance work?
  
  IFM is the policyholder and the members of the platform are the beneficiaries. Every member knows
  the insurance credit granted to him.
* How does the financing work?
  
  Buyers and Sellers can opt to delay payments up to 60 days or get paid immediately through IFM’s
  financing platform. Each Member looking to utilize this service will be allocated a credit limit.
* What is the LIVE Market?
  
  Through the Live market you can sell and buy your products without revealing your identity, thus
  not affecting your normal market.
* What are the OTC Trade?
  
  They are the tool through which you can record your sales / purchases, made with the normal tools
  of every day, but that through the registration on the platform, get insurance coverage, financial
  services and all the other benefits offered by IFM.
* What happens if I place an offer on IFM? Am I bound to sell it there?
  
  Absolutely not. You can withdraw your offers at any time or modify them if no transaction has
  taken place. If you execute a “LIVE MARKET” transaction, it will benefit from all the services and
  advantages offered by IFM including insurance and financial ones.

backgrounds ranging from the seafood industry to the financial sector

In 2002, Massimiliano left & launched his own independent seafood trading business & since then has
been focused on growing his business & his local market relationships. To this end Massimiliano
worked & lived in Scotland, Holland, Greece, Norway & has become an expert of the whole seafood
supply chain from farming & fishing to trading.

Massimiliano was born in Bologna, Italy & currently resides in Switzerland & enjoys fine wine &
sailing! He has been a licensed skipper for over 20 years!

##### [Stefano][29]

#### [Managing Partner & Head of Finance and Business Development][30]

Over 30 years experience in the financial, insurance and fintech sectors .

Seasoned C-Suite Executive with established experience in the investment banking, asset management &
corporate sectors including ground-up design, development, implementation & management of new &
award winning fintech & insurtech ventures, including online marketplaces, broker dealers & asset
managers.

Successful track record in investment banking that includes Deutsche Bank, Bear Stearns & Swiss Re
where trade finance receivable financing & insurance merged.

Stefano acted as Managing Partner/CIO for the turnaround of one the largest specialty finance
companies in the US & took it public on the NYSE in 4 years. Subsequently he built & sold a

Stefano was born in Modena, Italy & currently resides in New York, USA. Stefano is an

Fascinated by all the aspects of technology that contribute to making people's experience better

## Trading system & Marketplace

### InterFishMarket is a **neutral marketplace** and acts as an intermediary to all transactions and
### **does not take risk positions; the system works like the most established e-commerce
### platforms.**
### 
### Our goal is to facilitate exchange activities in a transparent and efficient way between buyers
### and sellers all over the world, while offering both parties **access to financial services like
### insurance and financing.**
### 
### It is possible to execute transactions in two ways:

## Online Trading – Live Market
* Enter your sales or purchase order.
* Receive offers and close transactions on the platform.
* Enjoy the insurance and financial benefits that IFM offers you.

## Offline Trading – OTC Trade
* Close your offline sales (as you do every day on the phone, e-mail or Skype).
* Register your Trade on the IFM platform.
* Enjoy the insurance and financial benefits that IFM offers you.

## FAQ

## Find the Answers Here
* How much does it cost?
  
  Subscribe for free, you will pay only and if you sell or buy, contact us for details.
* How does the insurance work?
  
  IFM is the policyholder and the members of the platform are the beneficiaries. Every member knows
  the insurance credit granted to him.
* How does the financing work?
  
  Buyers and Sellers can opt to delay payments up to 60 days or get paid immediately through IFM’s
  financing platform. Each Member looking to utilize this service will be allocated a credit limit.
* What is the LIVE Market?
  
  Through the Live market you can sell and buy your products without revealing your identity, thus
  not affecting your normal market.
* What are the OTC Trade?
  
  They are the tool through which you can record your sales / purchases, made with the normal tools
  of every day, but that through the registration on the platform, get insurance coverage, financial
  services and all the other benefits offered by IFM.
* What happens if I place an offer on IFM? Am I bound to sell it there?
  
  Absolutely not. You can withdraw your offers at any time or modify them if no transaction has
  taken place. If you execute a “LIVE MARKET” transaction, it will benefit from all the services and
  advantages offered by IFM including insurance and financial ones.

[Inven founders]
Ekku, Niilo, and Tommi
Co-founders, Inven

As analysts at McKinsey and BCG, we spent days searching for companies, piecing together ownership
and financial data, and rebuilding the same spreadsheets over and over again.

We thought there had to be a better way. In 2022, we set out to build it.

Since then, we’ve worked with 1,000+ M&A teams and spoken to thousands of professionals across
private equity, investment banking, consulting, and corporate development.

The core workflow is still the same — analyzing markets, finding the right companies, understanding
them, and reaching the right people. What’s changed is how it gets done.

That’s what we’re continuing to build: grounded in real data, shaped in close collaboration with the
teams doing the work, and evolving rapidly.

We are a boutique aquafeed manufacturer in Lombok, Indonesia
Our focus is on tropical spiny lobster and mud crab regenerative aquaculture innovation
Timothy Hromatka
Founder & Passionate Aquaculturist

### Aquafeed

We have the first commercially available and economical tropical spiny lobster aquafeed delivering
cost savings for farmers and faster growth rates. Our aquafeeds are made from premium ingredients
including seaweeds and manufactured with fermentation and cold extrusion process which preserves
essential amino acids and vitamins.

### Aquaculture

We are perfecting and scaling the land-based farming of mud crab and tropical spiny lobster to grow
the industry of these high-value crustacean species.

### Research

At our Living Seas Lab we conduct research in the nutritional and husbandry requirements of
high-valued crustaceans and are quick to innovate and continually run feed trials and stress and
disease challenges. We are also developing mangrove leaf-based nutraceuticals harnessing the
benefits of mangroves for aquatic animal health.

In addition to the commercial focus of our lab, we host intern students from the University of
Mataram Department of Aquaculture, enabling them to gain hands-on experience and conduct and publish
original research.

### Impact

As an impact driven company, we are developing regenerative aquaculture methods that are
commercially viable and help to regenerate some of Indonesia’s 600,000 hectares of degraded mangrove
forests.

## Why NMSC?

##### Accurate market positionings

01

Identify your competitive advantage with our comprehensive and detailed market positioning services.
We work with you to create a customer-centric strategy that will help you succeed in the
marketplace.

##### Market estimates & forecasts

02

Receive accurate estimates and forecasts for your industry with our expert analysis. We offer a
range of services, including opportunity analysis, competitive landscape assessments, and market
position studies.

##### Validation and data assurance checks

03

We have a process in place to run periodic checks on our data models to determine correlations
between macroeconomic datasets and our sourced market data to ensure maximum accuracy.

##### Profound data sources

04

We take our data sources seriously. Our data sources are deep-rooted, reliable, accurate, and
well-regarded, which include paid databases, primary research, statistical organizations, government
agencies, and industry intelligence providers, among others.

##### Industry analysis with clarity

05

Our market taxonomy allows you to work smarter by aligning your revenues with relevant market
metrics. We allow you to step back from tactical tasks of monitoring the markets - so you can
resurface from below the waterline.

##### N.E.X.T. insights

06

For a deeper dive into a niche sector, we present market financial information that is complete,
accurate, and verifiable through what we call N.E.X.T. Insights - so you can trust what you see.

We're Unlocking Plant Potential

#### EVOLVING AG

Nufarm is a global crop protection and seed technologies company that helps farmers and businesses
meet the global needs of food, feed, fibre and fuel production. We bring our proven agility,
capabilities and partnerships to help our customers in a rapidly changing world.

Nufarm's innovative seeds solutions help protect the world's natural resources and empower farmers
with new economic opportunities.

By unlocking the intrinsic value and commercial potential of Omega-3 canola, carinata, sorghum,
sunflower and energy cane, we empower growers and end-use customers to meet current and emerging
demand for generations to come.


Our regional teams deliver top seed, service and new opportunities for farm customers in Australia,
Europe, North and South America. Our local work combined with our global reach maximize our R&D and
help build strong Value Chains that supply sustainable plant-based solutions to our end-use
customers.

## ADDRESSING GLOBAL CHALLENGES WITH INNOVATIVE SOLUTIONS

Plants have incredible power to help solve important global challenges like human nutrition, soil
health and climate change.

### Nufarm Carinata:
### Helping decarbonize transport and regenerate soil

Nufarm Carinata is a non-food certifiable cover crop contract grown for sustainable low-carbon
energy feedstock. It reduces emissions when used to replace fossil fuels and removes carbon from the
air, restoring it to help regenerate soil as it grows between main crop rotations.

batteries—designed for quick replacement without shutdown. For extended missions, switch to our
Topside Power System (TPS) for a direct, uninterrupted power source. Ideal for demanding underwater
inspections, search & rescue, and offshore oil & gas operations.

requirements of EU markets in 2014.

## Leadership and Legacy

Raj Fishmeal and Oil Company is led by a multi-generational family leadership team that combines
engineering expertise, business management acumen, legal knowledge, and deep institutional
understanding of the marine ingredients industry.

Founded by late Shri Malpe Madhwaraj, a visionary entrepreneur and leader of the fishing community
in coastal Karnataka. He was a pioneer in the Indian fishmeal industry, who equipped the factory
with imported oil fiered flame driers. He also played a crucial role in developing the port of
Malpe.

Post his untimely demise in 1982, his wife Smt Manorama Madhwaraj took the reins. The factory was
also ably managed by late Sri Prasadraj (elder brother of Sri Pramod Madhwaraj). 2002 onwards, Sri
Pramod Madhwaraj headed the company, spearheading modernisation.

programs and quality upgrades.

## About RICHI MACHINERY

RICHI MACHINERY is a leading global manufacturer specializing in feed pellet machines, extruders,
wood pellet machines, and biomass pellet equipment. With over 30 years of manufacturing expertise
and project experience across more than 140 countries and regions, we offer complete equipment sets,
engineering design, installation, and turnkey project services to customers worldwide.

**Customized Equipment Solution**

Tailor-made pelletizing equipment based on raw materials, capacity, formulation, and project goals.

[icon]

**Complete Turnkey Project**

Full-process solutions covering plant layout, installation, commissioning, training, and after-sales
service.

[icon]

**Full Line & Full Process Supply**

One-stop equipment supply from crushing, mixing, pelletizing, cooling, screening to automatic
packaging systems.

**Global Technical Support**

RICHI’s experienced engineers ensure fast installation and long-term stable production.

[richi machinery]

## Customized Solutions for Your Project

For customers across different countries, markets, and product demands, RICHI can quickly provide
personalized solutions tailored to your specific project requirements. From individual machines to
complete turnkey plants, we design competitive equipment configurations and production processes
based on your budget, site conditions, and target market strategy—ensuring fast project delivery,
stable operation, and strong commercial returns in your local market.

[Get Your Solution>][150]

## Main machine recommendations

RICHI MACHINERY focuses on four core equipment : feed pellet machines, extruders, wood pellet
machines, and biomass pellet machines. With advanced technology and rich engineering experience, we
provide reliable equipment and complete solutions for both feed production and biomass energy
industries.

## About RICHI MACHINERY

RICHI MACHINERY is a leading global manufacturer specializing in feed pellet machines, extruders,
wood pellet machines, and biomass pellet equipment. With over 30 years of manufacturing expertise
and project experience across more than 140 countries and regions, we offer complete equipment sets,
engineering design, installation, and turnkey project services to customers worldwide.

**Customized Equipment Solution**

Tailor-made pelletizing equipment based on raw materials, capacity, formulation, and project goals.

[icon]

Full-process solutions covering plant layout, installation, commissioning, training, and after-sales
service.

[icon]

**Full Line & Full Process Supply**

One-stop equipment supply from crushing, mixing, pelletizing, cooling, screening to automatic
packaging systems.

**Global Technical Support**

RICHI’s experienced engineers ensure fast installation and long-term stable production.

stable operation, and strong commercial returns in your local market.

#### Despre noi

Cu o experiență de 12 ani în domeniul acvaculturii, ne-am dedicat pasiunii de a oferi soluții
nutritive de înaltă calitate pentru creșterea sănătoasă a păstrăvilor. Colaborarea noastră strânsă
cu Biomar, începută acum un deceniu, reflectă angajamentul nostru pentru excelență. Produsele
noastre sunt importate direct din Danemarca, garantând standarde ridicate de calitate și
performanță.
